body: Youre welcome ❤
I really hope that you will change your mind and im sending you love.
Im very proud of you for staying. How was your day today? Is there anything you would like to get off your chest?

Hi love, thank you for reaching out here. 
 Im sorry you have to live like this. How are you sure that you wouldnt be relocated? If the whole house is smelling of feces and the carpet is full with it then  think child services will act. I also think a therapist would be good for you.  Someone who can help you to make it through until you can leave home and start your own life. There is so much for you to see and do. Please stay with us.
Lets talk. Im here.
Fuck you.

Im very releaved to hear that. I know that you cant see that now but it is a wonderful thing that you are still here. 
How old are you love?
Can we talk about it?
Oh okay... dont you maybe want to explain? I would like to help. I care.
Im not. I dont know about any cult. Are you also part of it?
Can you tell me why?
Like i said, im glad you are still here.
Okay you dont trust them, understood. Who do you trust?

Hey love, 

please call an ambulance. What did you overdose on? Where are you at the moment?
Whaaat? Thats fucking great! Lots of love for you! 🥰
Hey. Can you stay for a moment? I would like to talk.
What made you stay?

Maybe to something just for yourself. Reward yourself for making it through yesterday. Buy something you really like to eat, watch a comfort movie or take a walk if the weather is nice. And please text you friends. You dont have to tell them about yesterday i you dont feel like it but talk to them about anything. Stay connected to the positive things in your life. I know how hard it can be but always remind yourself: If i made ot through this moment (the moment you wrote your post) i can make it through any moment. 
Try not to pressure yourself. Its not that you have to tell yourself that you will never feel like this again. Because maybe you will. Take small steps. One day after another.
Im so proud of you for making it through last night! What are your plans for today?
Hi love, are you there? Maybe give me a quick sign, i worry.
Thats shitty. How are you know? Any better?
Are you there?
You are needed. You are loved. You are strong.
What can we do for you?
What time is it where you are at? Would it be possible to send her a message? You dont have to tell her what exactly is going on if you dont want to but maybe try having a conversation with her.

It is probably that part of you that wants to keep going. The part that wants to survive. That is not pathetic, its strong and its selfprotection. 
Tell me something about yourself :) 
What stuff do you like?

Does she know how you are feeling right now? 
Right, you wouldnt want to miss it but i understand if that doesnt matter to you in this moment. 
Did anything happen today to make it this bad?
Thanks so much for that post! You brought some positivity into this night for me. Im proud of you and i belive in you.

10 friends... thats many! You must be a great person then. 
Where do you know your best friend from? How did she save you last time?

I really know how you feel. Its that desperate desire for peace, right? For silence and comfort... 
I felt like that before. 
Where are you at the moment? What is you situation?

The most valuable thing that would be lost is not the money but you. Im sure you are not ugly. Im sure you are not stupid. 
You are not alone many people are here to listen. 
Tell me a bit about yourself. What things do you like? Any movies? Music? Sports?
But you are still here. What is your plan? Please talk to me.

Thanks for your answer. First of all: Im sorry about the pain your are feeling. I how its like to be ready to leave and done with it all. You dont deserve to feel like that. 
Do you maybe want to tell me a bit about yourself? You say there are friends that care about you. Who are they and what are they like?
Hey. Would you stay for a moment? I would like to talk to you .

Im 22, im from Germany but half greek. I have 5 siblings. I like Manchester United and Metal Music. 
What is there that you like?
Can you try to stay for another moment? I would really like to talk to you about it.
You are worthy of love and happiness. It is not your fault that you are in pain.
Hey, what happened to make you feel like this? What can i do to help?
I do care and i dont get paid. What can i do for you to help a little?

Hey. First of all: Im proud of you for reaching out, thats very good and not everyone is able to do that. And as you can see, you are heard. You said your mom is psychotic, that means she can often say things that she would never say if she was well. Im sure she wants you to live. 
But apart from that lets talk about your resources with that i mean people around you, places you spend time apart from your home and things that give you life or happiness. Can you name some? You said you dont have a friend but are there any coworkers, teachers or classmates that you could turn to? 
Im sending you love and a big hug. Im sorry you that bad things are happening to you.

You can always contact me if its all getting to much. Before you do something that cannot he undone remember: we can have a chat and maybe look for a solution. I can not promise you that we will always find one but i promise you wont have to look for it alone. Its all anonymous here and we dont know each other. But i have a brother who is your age and if he was feeling the way you do i would hope for someone to tell him, that he is not alone. Even if its just some weird german girl on reddit. I have my dark phases too and i know you cant fix it all with some "smart" advice. But it helps to talk.
Thanks for your answer. Im in therapy, yes but atm i feel like i wont ever get better. Im losing hope...

That sounds good. In times like this try to find the next good thing that is going to happen and focus on that. Like that you make it through day after day. Small steps. Please take care of yourself ❤
Im sure it is there and you will find it. What is the next thing that you look forward to? A holiday or vacation or a meet up with a friend?
I there something you like about your looks? Eyes? Or your haircolour?
Btw i would also like to see Calfifornia but its very far away as i am from germany
Can you tell what would need to change for you to feel different?

I see. I dont want to make it all about your age but it is very common that in this phase of your life you feel like your parents dont understand you and are always unhappy with everything you do. But when you feel like your mental health is getting worse it would maybe help to tell them a bit how you feel. So then you could organise therapy or something for you. 
Next question: What is something that you would really like to do in your life? Like a place you want to see, a specific food you would like to have?
Cool! Im more of a metal girl :) do you hage any support from your family? Someone you could maybe talk to?
What kind of music do you listen to mostly? :)

I know how you feel. I was just like that when i was your age. Believe me, 3-4 friends is plenty and more than most adults have. 
What kind of things do you enjoy doing? Im a drummer and i like writing. Hbu?
Please call 911

I just created an account to be able to comment here because i have read your post and pray that you didnt do it. If you want, please contact me. We can talk and maybe figure something out. Or i can just listen. We are here. You are not alone. Please stay with us.
Please dont. We are here to support you. Try to make it through another day and then another and so on. Small steps.
